patch_description: The previous diff failed due to an indentation typo in the SEARCH block. This retry matches the code verbatim. The strategy: the current SLSQP-only approach scores poorly (0.16) because it starts from random sphere points. Instead, combine (1) a fast stochastic hill climber on the true (dmin/dmax)^2 objective from diverse structured and random seeds, with (2) SLSQP refinement of the best candidates using the exact max-min formulation: maximize t subject to t <= |xi-xj|^2 and |xi-xj|^2 <= 1 for all pairs. Warm-starting SLSQP near a good hill-climb optimum lets the smooth NLP polish the configuration precisely.
